Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Dana Point for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 26 (Happy Harbor Days Holiday Lights at Dana Point Harbor) through January 10, 2027 (Happy Harbor Days Holiday Lights at Dana Point Harbor), with Boat Ride with Santa (December 5 to December 6), Santa's Jolly Trolley Park Stops and La Plaza Park Tree Lighting (December 5) and Breakfast with Santa at Waldorf Astoria Monarch Beach (December 6 to December 20) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Dana Point

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Dana Point
  • 4 free events: Santa's Jolly Trolley Park Stops and La Plaza Park Tree Lighting, Pines Park Tree Lighting, 51st Annual Boat Parade of Lights and Holiday Market at Dana Point Harbor
  • Meet Santa: Boat Ride with Santa (December 5 and 6), Santa's Jolly Trolley (December 5), Breakfast with Santa at Waldorf Astoria Monarch Beach (December 6 to 20), Santa Paws (December 12 and 13) and Santa photos at the Holiday Market (December 19)
  • Parades and tree lightings: La Plaza Park Tree Lighting (December 5), Pines Park Tree Lighting (December 7) and the 51st Annual Boat Parade of Lights (December 11 to 13)
  • Lights: Happy Harbor Days at Dana Point Harbor (through January 10, 2027)
  • Trains: none found in town; the Santa's Jolly Trolley on December 5 is a trolley ride to four parks
  • Season: November 26 to January 10, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Dana Point families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Anaheim, which covers Knott's Merry Farm, the Anaheim Tree Lighting Ceremony and Anaheim Ballet's Nutcracker.
